title: sse: fix partial-JSON streaming delimiter ordering and chunk framing (OpenAI compat)
author: Evelyn Chen
release_notes: Fixes streaming SSE chunking and framing bugs that could produce malformed partial JSON events or deliver tokens out of order; improves OpenAI-compat streaming adapter stability.
description: Fixes several edge cases in the SSE streaming stack that led to malformed partial-JSON events, incorrect delimiter ordering between token/event frames, and occasional token reordering under high-concurrency workloads. This change stabilizes the framer/parser contract, tightens invariants around boundary tokens and partial JSON decorations ("data:" prefixes, newline delimiters, and event termination), and updates the OpenAI compatibility adapter to preserve event ordering and to retry transient framing mismatches. Includes unit + integration tests and an e2e streaming test that reproduces the original failure mode. Motivation: customers using streaming structured output (function/tool-calls and partial JSON objects) observed intermittent parse errors in downstream OpenAI-compatible clients (observed as truncated JSON payloads or misplaced delimiter tokens). The fix avoids changing the external API surface; it instead hardens server-side framing and makes the adapter tolerant to interleaved partial fragments while preserving ordering guarantees. Checklist: 1) add framer and parser invariants and tests; 2) update OpenAI adapter to buffer until event-complete; 3) add integration test with function-calling structured JSON stream; 4) run perf smoke to ensure no regression; 5) update changelog and add release note. Impact: no breaking API changes; minor CPU overhead on pathological workloads (microbenchmarked <1% in our canary).
